scope: One matched CPU comparison from C749 with unchanged progression rewards, architecture and mixed training curriculum.
optimizer: Fresh Adam, epsilon 1e-5, unchanged PPO clipping and entropy coefficients
spawn_heading_policy: Use the original training WADs and headings in both arms. Reflection affects only the auxiliary objective.

losses.reference: Sum over six action heads of KL(frozen C749 || learner) averaged over genuine rollout contexts.
losses.symmetry: Average of the two KL directions between original and mirrored learner action heads after undoing action reflection. Stop gradient through each KL target.
